fixtureSemantics: Each group starts from complete base typed before/desired-after records and exact unsubmitted payloads; overlays never modify those files.
Path selectors with [id=...] and operations are declarative fixture instructions, not executable JSON Patch or production code.
Synthetic comparison-only values must be confined to fake responses; never sent to production requirements.
Each control deliberately supplies wrong observations or decisions; the assertion must reject it inside a passing harness.
Expected negative rejection is not an acceptable red unit-test suite.
Scenarios requiring already-approved state use a test-only approval fixture; these artifacts do not grant actual approval.
Server errors include 400/404/409, timeout, cancellation, 401, 503 and unreadable/queued responses where the group names uncertainty.
Model all fourteen records and seven mappings; do not reduce fixture denominators to one convenient record.

groups.name: ExactPacketAndApproval
groups.positiveScenario: Explicit approval binds the exact proposal, API evidence and fixture hashes; writer exclusion is documented; prepare only.
requiredAssertions: Journal ready-not-written; zero mutations.
Any semantic edit invalidates the approval binding.

groups.name: UniqueOrdinalTypedIdentity
groups.positiveScenario: Exactly one typed record for each of the 14 kind/ID pairs.
requiredAssertions: Match kind and case-sensitive ID.
Do not select the first duplicate or another collection.

groups.name: PresenceAndType
groups.positiveScenario: Compare explicitly present JSON values without scalar coercion or missing-property substitution.
requiredAssertions: Empty array differs from null and absence.
Boolean false differs from string false and number 0.
Number 1 differs from string 1.

groups.name: StableMetadata
groups.positiveScenario: Full typed before/after responses preserve all unmodified exposed fields; separately retain workflow-derived fields.
requiredAssertions: Preserve notes, scope and linkedUseCases including presence and ordered content.
Do not claim fields absent from typed models are stored metadata.
Unknown newly exposed fields require classification before mutation.

groups.name: VolatileReadTimestamps
groups.positiveScenario: Workflow observation times change between reads, while stable typed fields remain identical; preserve raw observations and omit timestamps from patch.
requiredAssertions: Only named synthesized createdAt/updatedAt are excluded.
Actual stored historical metadata remains unproven through these models.

groups.name: ExactChangedFields
groups.positiveScenario: Emit only kind/id plus approved changedFields, mapping body/condition to description exactly as pinned.
requiredAssertions: Compare exact full payload to unsubmittedBatch.params.
Other API-supported aliases are not intrinsically invalid, but cannot silently change this approved packet.
No area/subarea/testType/linkedUseCases or timestamps in batch patch.

groups.name: AcIdentityAndMeaning
groups.positiveScenario: All 66 original AC IDs retained, 90 desired criteria, with exact approved text/order/flags/evidence.
requiredAssertions: 66 retained IDs: 56 rewritten texts and 10 unchanged; 24 added.
Every desired satisfaction flag false.
Counts alone never prove identity or meaning.

groups.name: MappingExistenceAndPreservation
groups.positiveScenario: All old and final target IDs exist in their exact kinds; desired full-row union sent; order-only readback changes accepted.
requiredAssertions: Map edge comparison is ordinal set equality after duplicate detection.
Retain every old edge and workspaceId.
No write when already equal.
Read error never means empty mapping.

groups.name: DriftBeforeFirstWrite
groups.positiveScenario: Immediately fresh baseline and documented exclusive-writer condition hold before batch and each mapping write.
requiredAssertions: No external edit overwritten.
No unverified local lock called server-wide exclusion.
No compare-and-swap guarantee inferred from read then write.

groups.name: BatchSuccessNeedsReadback
groups.positiveScenario: Batch reports success; all 14 full typed records equal desired state including stable fields; only then allow mapping phase.
requiredAssertions: Exactly one batch call.
Read every record before any mapping call.
Queued is not primary persisted.

groups.name: BatchRejectedNoMutation
groups.positiveScenario: Validation/missing/conflict rejection followed by exact full before-state; journal records-confirmed-before; no mappings.
requiredAssertions: Source atomicity is a contract input, not a live fault-injection result.
400, 404 and 409 retain response details.
Do not report applied from any rejected response.

groups.name: LostAcknowledgementApplied
groups.positiveScenario: One batch call times out; full readback equals exact after-state; record confirmed applied and suppress replay.
requiredAssertions: Write call count exactly one.
Confirm all 14 records and stable fields.
Do not confuse missing HTTP acknowledgement with failed mutation.

groups.name: LostAcknowledgementUnapplied
groups.positiveScenario: One batch call times out; full readback equals exact before-state; stop with records-confirmed-before.
requiredAssertions: No automatic retry.
A later authorized retry needs fresh complete preflight, exact still-valid approval and writer window.
Local journal ID is not a server idempotency key.

groups.name: UnknownOrMixedOutcome
groups.positiveScenario: Unavailable or mixed/third-state readback stops all mutations and preserves full uncertainty.
requiredAssertions: No automatic compensation.
Potential server-internal rollback does not establish observed before-state.
Do not interpret an unavailable read as authoritative absence.

groups.name: PartialMappingSequence
groups.positiveScenario: Two rows confirmed desired, third call fails and reconciles before, remaining four untouched; journal mapping-partial-stop.
requiredAssertions: Retain exact seven-row states and each invocation.
Do not claim one transaction across batch and mappings.
Do not reapply the two confirmed rows.

groups.name: FinalWholeScopeReadback
groups.positiveScenario: All 14 typed records, 90 AC and seven full mapping rows equal approved desired state; exposed stable fields preserved.
requiredAssertions: Independent final read, not echoed response.
Exact ordered criteria plus ordinal mapping sets.
Data verified still awaits exports, traceability and HV.

groups.name: PersistenceAndExportEvidence
groups.positiveScenario: Exact full verdict/request/response and operation journal persist with verified readback; export and traceability receipts retain actual outputs.
requiredAssertions: Primary, queued and unknown are distinct.
Traceability exit 0 is not complete AC coverage.
Any failed required export or persistence gate blocks completion.

groups.name: NoUnapprovedRecoveryOrDone
groups.positiveScenario: Every failure preserves history and leaves requirements/TODO/goal unaccepted; only approved batch and mapping mutations allowed.
requiredAssertions: Detect forbidden calls even if final values are restored.
No native changes, deletion/recreation or historic queue replay.
No satisfaction or done transition before required independent acceptance.
